description: Topology-preserving simplified fallback derived programmatically from the official GRDC ArcGIS FeatureServer response used in successful workflow run 47.
query: grdc_no IN (4146081,4146080); outFields=*; returnGeometry=true; outSR=4326; f=geojson
intended_use: Network-failure fallback for study-area overview rendering and station-context recovery only; not a replacement for official full-resolution basin geometry in quantitative spatial analysis.
